title: Transition Finish at Speed
description: Players sprint the floor and finish at full speed off a pass, training the composure needed to finish layups when breathing hard in transition.

content.objective: Stay composed and finish cleanly while breathing hard and moving at full speed.
content.setup: A passer stands near half court; the finisher sprints from the baseline to receive a pass in stride.
instructions: The finisher sprints the length of the floor at game speed.
The passer leads the ball to where the finisher will be, not where they are now.
The finisher gathers in stride and finishes without breaking speed.
Jog back and repeat, alternating which side the finisher sprints down.
coachingPoints: Gather with both hands even at full speed.
Take the correct last two steps regardless of fatigue.
Keep the eyes up to track the pass the whole way.
commonMistakes: Slowing down awkwardly to gather the pass.
Rushing the finish and missing an easy look from fatigue.
Bringing the ball down low where it can be knocked away.
content.safety: Keep the finishing lane clear of any other group's drill.
